notes.title: Going back to the basics
notes.notes:
Countdowns players,

As I have been working to bring the next evolution of countdown, my vision for the game has changed drastically. After some heavy deliberation, I have decided to re-release a stable version from March. With this comes a few different things to note:

[list]
[*] Only game-breaking bug fixes will be addressed while I focus my efforts on the new version of the game
[*] This version will eventually get a major overhaul, once I finish work on the new game. ( No expected timeline on this )
[/list]

notes.title: Countdown Early Access Release!
notes.notes:
We are a go for early access release! 

Currently working features:

Humans:
Proximity chat
Call emergency meetings by reporting dead bodies to vote to eject the rogue AI
Complete tasks to delay the prepare your ship for evacuation
Androids will attempt to thwart your efforts by hacking your visor or ejecting you from the airlock

Androids:
Kill humans and frame other humans
Hack the systems on board to prey on the humans

Features:
Customize victory conditions and various cooldowns
In game chat
Pick your color

Please report any bugs on the steam community forum. Or if you're interested in joining our discord, let us know and we can give you a invite link.

bugs@hellofriendgames.com
